sanskrit_verse:
अन्यायवादिनः सभ्यास् तथैवोत्कोचजीविनः ।
विश्वस्ते वञ्चकाश् चैव निर्वास्याः सर्व एव ते ॥ १,१.१०७
transliteration: anyāyavādinaḥ sabhyās tathaivotkocajīvinaḥ / viśvaste vañcakāś caiva nirvāsyāḥ sarva eva te // BrhS_1,1.107
sph_interpretive_translation: All those who advocate injustice, live by exploitation, and deceive the trusting shall be removed from all positions of influence and authority.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation arises from alignment with cosmic integrity
Restoration logic demands removal of corruptive presence
Consciousness alignment necessitates purification of social roles
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual advocates unjust laws THEN remove from judicial or legislative capacity
IF an individual exploits positional power for personal gain THEN disqualify from holding office
IF an individual deceives a trusting party THEN revoke authority in societal governance systems
IF any agent violates pramāṇa-based truth THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any judge, counsel, or litigant found advocating falsehoods or exploiting process for ulterior motives must be immediately disqualified and removed from participation. The threshold of responsibility lies not in intent alone but in alignment with Sanātana Dharma axioms.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that distortion of truth creates causal imbalance. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how false advocacy manifests systemic decay. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of misalignment from Sanātana Nyāya. Enforcement focuses on realignment, not punitive exile.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Require full acknowledgment of harm caused through false advocacy
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Mandate corrective action to restore affected parties
Capacity Restoration: Enroll in consciousness elevation programs until fit for reintegration
Integrity Reintegration: Only after verified alignment with Dharma-pramāṇa, permit return to societal function
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
